objective: Reconcile stale canonical state, designate the human-approved Carolina roadmap section candidate as the canonical reference implementation for ROADMAP-VERTICAL-PROGRESS-001, and extract a source-independent behavior core without creating a reusable promotion or product integration.

stages.name: CANONICAL_STATE_RECONCILIATION
actions: Inspect only canonical structured sources that still contradict the consumed 173 result.
Synchronize ERR-LAB-011 closed, PEND-LAB-046 closed, candidate 002 approved, authorization 173 consumed and prior active execution authority none.
Preserve the global Priority Integrations phase and unrelated state.

stages.name: CANONICAL_REFERENCE_DESIGNATION
actions: Designate the existing candidate 002 REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATION.html as the canonical reference implementation for ROADMAP-VERTICAL-PROGRESS-001.
Reference the immutable artifact without copying, moving, rewriting or modifying it.
Keep the pre-existing neutral implementation rejected as canonical reference and preserved as a historical neutral derivation.

stages.name: BEHAVIOR_CORE_EXTRACTION
actions: Create an isolated source-independent behavior core under the ROADMAP-VERTICAL-PROGRESS-001 package.

Preserve scroll-linked progress, live measurement, resize remeasurement, dynamic trailing space, node activation, independent reveal, terminal state, no dead scroll, reduced motion final state and load/font stabilization.
Exclude Carolina text, brand, typography, colors, icons, clinical content, editorial composition and product assets.
Create contracts, isolated harness and validation evidence needed to prove parity.

acceptance_checks: Canonical state contains no material contradiction about ERR-LAB-011, PEND-LAB-046, candidate 002 or authorization 173.
Candidate 002 is designated as canonical reference implementation by pointer and protected blobs remain exact.
Historical neutral derivation remains preserved and cannot impersonate the reference.
Behavior core exposes source-independent measurement and application contracts.
Harness validates normal and reduced motion, resize, late stabilization, terminal state, no post-terminal dead scroll, no horizontal overflow and no external requests.
No reusable promotion, product integration, runtime or deployment claim is created.
